fields.description: Turn the side chat off site-wide. The widget still renders in its locked state so the reason is visible rather than mysterious.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Which API the model is called through. `openai` covers every OpenAI-compatible endpoint — OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq, vLLM, LM Studio.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: The API's base URL, without the trailing path.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The model id, exactly as the provider knows it.
fields.label: Model
Extra Options
fields.description: Options for the provider that the app has no field for, as a JSON object — for example {"setCacheKey": "True"}. They are added to the request the app sends. A string that spells true or false becomes the boolean it means; the app's own settings are never overwritten by them.
The provider's API key. Stored encrypted; it is never sent to the browser and never written to a log.
fields.label: API Key
Test the connection
fields.description: Calls the provider with the smallest question that means anything, and says what happened. The values in this form are used, so a provider can be tested before it is saved.
Lower is more literal. Keep it low for a tool-using assistant: a high temperature turns a schema into a guess.
fields.label: Temperature

fields.description: The largest answer the model may produce, in tokens. Generous on purpose: a ceiling that cuts an answer off mid-sentence makes the assistant look as though it has run out of words. Lower it only if a provider refuses a request as too expensive.
fields.label: Max Tokens

fields.description: How long a single provider call may take, in seconds.
fields.label: Timeout (s)

fields.description: When the primary provider fails, try this one before giving up. A fallback on a different vendor is worth much more than one on the same vendor.
fields.label: Enable Fallback

fields.description: The fallback's base URL, without the trailing path.
fields.label: Fallback Base URL

fields.description: The fallback's model id, exactly as the provider knows it.
fields.label: Fallback Model

fields.description: Roles allowed to use the chat, one per line. Leave empty to allow only System Managers. A name that is not a role is refused when you save.
fields.label: Chat Roles

fields.description: Roles allowed to see the side-chat widget, one per line. Leave empty to allow every user who may chat. A name that is not a role is refused when you save.
fields.label: Widget Roles

fields.description: Show the side-chat widget on every Desk page.
fields.label: Enable Widget

fields.description: Which corner the widget sits in. On an Arabic interface it mirrors automatically.
fields.label: Widget Position

fields.description: How many tool rounds one question may take. A backstop against a runaway loop, not a budget: the assistant answers with what it has found when it is reached, rather than apologising for stopping.
fields.label: Max Tool Rounds

fields.description: How many past messages are replayed to the model as context. Generous, so a long conversation does not make the assistant forget what it was told.
fields.label: History Limit

fields.description: How long one turn may run, in seconds.
fields.label: Turn Timeout (s)
Price per Million Tokens
fields.description: What a million tokens cost, in this site's currency. The chat prices a turn with it, so the ledger is in your currency and not in the provider's. Leave it at 0 and the cost is not known.
How many questions one person may ask per minute, per surface. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Turns / Minute

fields.description: Tool names to switch off, one per line. A tool that is off is never mentioned to the model, so it is never called.
fields.label: Disabled Tools

fields.description: Let the assistant create documents. When this is off, the write tool is not in the tool set at all — the model is never told it exists — so nothing can be created through the chat. Switch it on when you want the assistant to be able to write.
fields.label: Allow Writes

fields.description: Replaces the built-in instructions. Leave empty to use the defaults.
fields.label: System Prompt
